primary_conclusions: The source says all kathadi, not only katha/gana and not only Lat Prathama Eka. The examples illustrate a branch in stem formation before intrinsic nic.

The named adanta section begins with katha and continues through the listed later examples; no new heading ends it at laja. All35selected hardfamilies belong to this printed adanta discussion. Applying the word kathadi to every later entry remains a transparent scope inference, not an individually printed puK form.

The18Parasmaipada present cells for katha/gana and their2singular imperatives can be derived from the expressly licensed stems plus ordinary primary inflection rules; printed attestation of each form is unnecessary. This is a proposed source adjudication, not an adopted whitelist.
Puk applies on a nic branch; it cannot silently convert a non-nic alternate into a nic form or override intrinsic middle-only restrictions.
Literary kathapaya and kathapayamasa are directly attested but their message-sending contexts permit causative analysis. They do not independently establish ordinary-task identity.
No automatic full-tense or full35family answer union is approved here.

derivation_steps: Keep dictionary identity 10.0389 kaTa/Curadi/vAkyaprabanDe or10.0391 gaRa/Curadi/saNKyAne. No added sanadi or prefix.

Use ordinary Curadi svartha-nic (3.1.25), the named alternative kathadi reading, final-a strengthening (7.2.115) with displaced a-lopa as explained in Balam., then root-final puK before nic (7.3.36). This yields kathaap-/ganaap- with the root vowel positions intact.
Add Kartari sap (3.1.68); nic vowel guna (7.3.84) and ecoyavayavah (6.1.78) give kaTApaya-/gaRApaya-.

Select the Parasmaipada ending of3.4.78; Kasika prints the corresponding nine a-stem surface endings. First-person stem-final a lengthens before m/v by7.3.101. The resulting9forms per root are listed explicitly.

For Lot Madhyama Eka,3.4.87 replaces sip byhi;6.4.105 deletes hi after the short-a stem. Thus kaTApaya / gaRApaya. These are rule-derived ordinary-task forms; the literary example is corroborating shape only.

direct_other_coordinate_witnesses.identity_limit: Command to have a message sent to Viradhavala; causative reading plausible; not independent ordinary-root proof.
Minister sends/reports a response; ordinary narration versus causative message-sending not decisively separated.

unresolved: Exact per-root derivations for other33families are not materialized here, especially nine entries following the general puK sentence; source does not enumerate those individual puK outputs.
Laja10.0463 is literal laja in the task. The printed lanjapayati belongs to an alternative idit laji reading in the surrounding passage; do not add nasalized forms solely by copying that witness.

Pada10.0440 andkuha10.0443 are inside the explicit intrinsic middle-only ag arva range. General puK must preserve that restriction. Garva andkatra require their existing nic/no-nic branch distinctions.

The puK branch displaces a-lopa; therefore the standard aglopin aorist inhibition cannot simply be inherited. Aorist forms require fresh7.4.1/7.4.2/7.4.93/7.4.94 and reduplication/deletion analysis. Do not insert p into a canonical aorist.
Lit auxiliaries/pada and nonpresent nic deletion/it/strengthening are not fully derived here. Their validity can be proven by primary general rules, but present morphology alone is insufficient.
This branch cannot justify p-less kaTAyati or kATayati. An altered dictionary reading, additional causative operation or prefix needs its own task-level authorization.
